headline: Three o'clock keeps its own counsel.
body: A radiator clicks once and falls quiet. Outside, one window stays lit three floors up. The tea has gone cold in its cup.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: clear, bare branches against the dark

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: wet pavement reflecting a single streetlamp

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: desk lamp pooling on the open page
